verdict: Lead volume dropped sharply this week; Google spend gaps are being fixed now.
narrative: This period you received 17 leads at an average cost of $143.95 per lead, but the last 7 days saw an 80% drop in leads compared to the 7 days before — with zero leads on each of the final three days of the window. That collapse traces directly to Google Ads spend hitting $0 on three of the last five days, eliminating auction volume entirely during those stretches. Google Business Profile activity also fell 63% week-over-week, cutting off a secondary source of inbound traffic. Bid pacing and spend continuity on the Local Services campaign are being addressed immediately to restore auction presence. You should expect lead volume to stabilize as spend resumes; the next report will confirm whether the floor has held.
